goal: Collect clean non-sandbox Stage 7/post-box sequence controls and additional ownership-gap examples before any runtime selector, arbiter, or plan-capsule repair.

positive_sequence_control: artifact produced without Stage 7 repair sandbox flags
trace includes initial selected move and enough handoff/plan evidence to classify post-box continuation
not sourced only from candidate repair, support adapter, role-owned arbitration, or plan-capsule micro-tuning runs
hard_negative_sequence_control: playout_result == max_plies or draw within h40
selected provider/move and failure class visible
ownership_gap_positive: alternative existing provider forced at h40 mates
current owner and target provider visible
protected_safe_owner_control: monitor/phase terms may be present but should not imply forced owner exit

collection_phases.name: replay_free_artifact_classification
collection_phases.work: Classify existing Stage 7 artifacts as clean-baseline/default-off versus repair-sandbox-sourced.

collection_phases.name: replay_free_clean_control_recovery
collection_phases.work: Recover only clean h40 post-box mate/max_plies controls from baseline/default-off artifacts with selected move/provider evidence.

collection_phases.name: bounded_missing_cell_labels
collection_phases.work: If clean controls remain insufficient, run a tiny h40 label job with current defaults and no repair flags, tracing failures only.
